title: Port Hardy Museum

services.name: Permanent Exhibits
services.desc: Our museum covers several key themes that are central to Port Hardy's history. While our exhibits are in the process of being reviewed and updated, we continue to offer a range of displays that highlight the following: The Port Hardy Museum & Archives caretakes numerous cultural treasures from many local and unknown Nations. Identified belongings are connected with the Kwakiutl, Quatsino, Nakwaxda'xw, Gwa'sala, Interior Salish, and Nuu-chah-nulth Nations. Other belongings are currently under study to determine their provenance. We currently host some of the belongings associated with archeological explorations in the area. blurb: The Port Hardy Museum is located on the unceded homelands of the Kwakiutl First Nation in Gwa’dzi’ (Hardy Bay), a place of longstanding gathering and exchange for many coastal nations.
